Meet Global Certify

We've made the journey. Now we help you make yours.

Global Certify is a South African agency supporting students who want to study in Russia. Our team brings first-hand experience of both systems and a shared commitment to clear, personal guidance.

From your first question to your first days on campus, we help make each next step feel more manageable.
